messages:
Marta (CS Ops): FYI — noticing a cluster of onboarding timeouts tied to preprocessing today. need a short outbound and plan for credits / office hours.
Owen (Success Eng): can eng confirm root cause and ETA? ill draft the customer copy when we have it.
Ken (Infra Eng): preliminary: tokenization pipeline backlog combined with small-worker churn. when many small docs hit the tokenizer, queue depth rose and workers dropped due to a supervising health check. pushed a stabilization patch at 2025-06-22T13:05Z to decouple health check from short GC pauses.
Zoe (SRE): impact window ~12:4013:15 UTC. observed timeout rate peak ~8.5% for onboarding flows that include document preprocessing. we bumped worker capacity and set conservative retry jitter to reduce thundering-herd behavior; service healthy now.
Priya (CS Lead): product ok with a one-time credit for affected onboarding tenants? i need wording for the outbound.
Owen (Success Eng): draft outbound (short): "Hi — we experienced intermittent onboarding timeouts affecting document preprocessing for some new customers this morning. Status: a stability patch has been deployed and were running a 24h canary while we validate telemetry. Next: if the canary is green well roll the patch wide within 36h. Compensation: a one-time onboarding credit will be applied automatically to affected accounts. Well host a 30m office hours and post the recording. Support: https://support.redwood.ai/onboard-help"
Marta (CS Ops): tiny edits: change "36h" -> "within 3648h" and add link to quick ticket form for urgent cases: https://support.redwood.ai/urgent-onboard.
Priya (CS Lead): product confirmed the one-time credit. please ensure renewals get a list of impacted trial accounts for proactive outreach.
Ken (Infra Eng): technical note for RCA: root cause = tokenizer backlog + supervised worker flapping during GC spikes; fix = decouple health-check timeout & increase short-lived worker cap. adding synthetic test to reproduce GC-induced churn.
Zoe (SRE): SRE action items: 1) new dashboard panel for preprocessing queue depth 2) alert if queue depth > 75th percentile + sustained 2m 3) runbook entry to temporarily increase worker cap during onboarding surges.
Owen (Success Eng): customer-facing timeline line: "ETA for full confidence: 2472h canary; full rollout within 3648h if no regressions." good?
Priya (CS Lead): yes. also request legal quick-check on outbound language (avoid promising SLA credits).
Marta (CS Ops): office hours asked — who can host tech Q&A?
Ken (Infra Eng): i can join and cover the infra details + timeline.
Zoe (SRE): ill bring the monitoring graphs and mitigation checklist.
Owen (Success Eng): ill host CS and handle credits/questions. OpsBot please create event + incident.
OpsBot: Event created: "Onboarding preprocessing Q&A"  2025-06-23T16:00:00Z (30m). Incident ticket: https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2025-2299. Recording will be attached.
Marta (CS Ops): draft outbound updated with edit and support link; please react with :white_check_mark: after review.
Ken (Infra Eng): :white_check_mark: added the synthetic test to the RCA checklist.
Zoe (SRE): :white_check_mark: Ill post dashboard links when canary telemetry is stable.
Priya (CS Lead): :white_check_mark: ill prepare the high-touch list and DM renewals.
Marta (CS Ops): legal check requested; will queue outbound for EOD send after legal signoff. credits to be queued within 48h of send.
Owen (Success Eng): quick technical snippet for FAQ if asked: 
```
Patch summary: decouple tokenizer health-check -> avoid worker restart on short GC pause
Deployed: 2025-06-22T13:05Z -> canary
Guardrails: worker_cap + jittered_retries + queue-depth alert
```
Marta (CS Ops): perfect. closing thread for now  will reopen with RCA link and recording after office hours.
OpsBot: Thread status: pending RCA & recording."
